



# old notes, went to the container route.

```bash

ip netns add testvpn

# target adapter to move to the namespace:
ip link set ens19 down
ip link set ens19 netns testvpn
ip netns exec testvpn bash

# Loopback up
ip link set lo up
ip link set ens19 up

touch /etc/dhcpcd.conf
dhcpcd

# (set the variable `Table = off` on the autogenerated wireguard config, can differ for openvpn):
sed 's/\[Interface\]/[Interface]\nTable = off\nPostUp = mkdir -p /etc/netns/testvpn && grep "^DNS" %i.conf | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d " " | tr "," "\n" > /etc/netns/testvpn/resolv.conf/g' /etc/vpn/tun0.conf > /etc/vpn/tun1.conf
chmod 600 /etc/vpn/tun1.conf



# bring interface up
```
